patterns.list_view_pattern: Django list views use Paginator for pagination. Paginator internally calls .count() on the queryset to determine total pages.
patterns.duplicate_count_pattern: Views call queryset.count() separately and also pass queryset to Paginator, causing two COUNT queries
patterns.correct_pattern: Use paginator.count property instead of queryset.count() to avoid duplicate queries

existing_implementations.description: Found 3 list views with duplicate count queries
existing_implementations.solution: Replace queryset.count() with paginator.count to reuse the COUNT query already executed by Paginator

performance_impact.issue: Each duplicate COUNT query adds 50-100ms on large tables
